name: Web search
summary: Giving the model a tool that runs live web searches and returns results with citations, so answers can use information newer than its training data. Most model APIs offer it as a built-in server-side tool; alternatively the harness calls a search API such as Exa, Tavily or Parallel.
how: Enable the provider's built-in search tool or wire a search API as a tool
Let the model decide when to search and with what query
Feed results back with source URLs
facts: web_search server tool, $10 per 1,000 searches plus tokens
web_search tool in the Responses API, domain filters up to 100
Allowed/blocked domains, max uses, user location
Fresh facts, but results add tokens and injection risk
goodFor: Questions about recent events or prices
watchOut: Results count as input tokens on every later turn
